{{Locations|Engi Controlled Sector|Engi Homeworlds|store=true|LRSmap=noship}}


The intro text for this event varies, and could be any of the following:
*''The Engi can do remarkable things with just a pile of scrap. The Engi hive at this beacon are selling equipment for just that.''
*''A message arrives: "Your scrap, ours. Our weapons for you." You're about to raise the shields when you realize it's just an Engi trader looking for a trade.''
*''An Engi ship hails: "Engine upgrade necessary for travel home. Sale of equipment necessary for engine upgrade."''
**A [[Stores and resources|store]] opens.

==Trivia==
This event is called "STORE_ENGI" in the datafiles.
